Sam (People Ops): Single-page content below (paste into docs/calendar):

MANAGER FIRST-WEEK HANDBOOK (copyable)

WEEK -1 (manager prep) ~20min
- Send welcome note with start logistics, buddy name, and ask about accommodations
- Open access ticket(s): Okta group, Slack invite, GitHub team, Google Drive, cloud role, badge if onsite
- Draft 3 outcome-level 90-day targets and attach to day1 1:1
- Pick a buddy + mentor (mentor = optional 4-week check-in)

DAY 1 (limit to 3-4 meetings; prefer morning orientation)
09:30-10:15 Manager 1:1: role scope, 90-day outcomes, immediate priorities
Manager 1:1 opener (psych-safety): "Welcome — my role this week is to remove blockers. Tell me what you need to feel productive; nothing is too small."
11:00-11:30 Team kickoff: quick intros + org map (record; link in invite)
14:00-14:30 Buddy session: dev env, run-first-app, first PR pairing, show team norms doc
16:30 Manager wrap: quick pulse, confirm access and accommodations

DAYS 2-5
- 10:00 15min daily huddle (live or async depending on timezone)
- Schedule 2 domain deep dives: product domain + infra/dev loop
- Mentor week1 kickoff (if assigned): 30min

DAY 7 MANAGER SIGNOFF (3 bullets)
- New hire opened or merged a PR with buddy guidance
- Buddy confirms dev env, tests run, and any accommodations met
- Manager delivered 30-day checkpoint and assigned a small ownership task

DAY 14 MINI-RETRO (15min)
- Manager + new hire: what went well, main blockers, remaining access items
- Assign owners + deadlines for any remaining blockers

ACCESS CHECK (quick)
- Okta group added, Slack invite sent
- GitHub org membership + repo team access
- Google Drive onboarding folder shared
- Cloud role (read) assigned; escalate for write access as needed
- Laptop ordered or imaged. If provisioning stalls: DM @it-support and cc @sam

ESCALATION MATRIX
- GitHub/org invites: DM @dev-platform -> escalate to @it-support after 24h
- Okta/Slack: DM @it-support (label: "onboarding-access {name}")
- Cloud roles: DM @infra-ops and open ticket if cross-team
- If blocked >24h: cc Sam (People Ops) so we can white-glove it

REMOTE WHITE-GLOVE FLOW (optional)
- Manager books: 60min screenshare with IT via @it-support (VPN + image + package install)
- IT owner runs remote bootstrap and verifies first build/run with the buddy present

30/60/90 (one-line outcomes + measurable check)
- 30d: orient & contribute - KPI: first PR merged + 3 cross-team intros completed
- 60d: own & stabilize - KPI: feature deployed to staging + runbook updated
- 90d: lead & improve - KPI: deliverable with measurable impact (perf/cost/quality)

WHO OWNS WHAT (one line)
- Manager: outcomes, roadmap context, growth expectations, 30/60/90 alignment
- Buddy: dev loop, repo walkthrough, first PR pairing, daily unblocker
- Mentor: learning plan, weekly check-ins (if assigned)
- People Ops: payroll, benefits, laptop/order, access escalation coordinator

QUICK SETUP HINTS
- Mac: after VPN run `curl -sSL https://redwood.tools/bootstrap | sh`
- Linux: `./scripts/bootstrap-dev && ./scripts/run-local`
- Docker local issues: try `docker system prune --volumes` then re-run

TEMPLATES (copyable)
Manager welcome email:
"Hi {name}, welcome to Team X! Your buddy is {buddy}. Day1 09:30-10:15 for a short orientation where we'll share 3x90 goals. If you need any accommodations, let me know. See you on {start_date}."

Slack intro:
"Please welcome {name} to Team X as {role}! Buddy: {buddy}. Mentor: {mentor}. Fun fact: {one-liner} :tada:"

NOTES
- Record team kickoff for timezoneed hires and offer async standup when needed
- Explicitly ask about accessibility during pre-board and day1
- Day7 signoff and Day14 retro reduce mid-ramp dropoffs
